story_description: Implement all settings category views and their entry points.
task_description: Users need to configure file viewer behavior including line numbers, word wrap, tab size, and diff style.
atom_description: Users need to configure file viewer behavior including line numbers, word wrap, tab size, and diff style.
problem_statement: Users need to configure file viewer behavior including line numbers, word wrap, tab size, and diff style.
scope_in: Line numbers toggle; word wrap toggle; tab size picker; diff style (unified/split); syntax theme
Implement FilesSettingsView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Actual file rendering; syntax highlighting implementation
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Diff style affects diff view layout
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
nonfunctional_requirements: Changes apply to open files immediately
Must not block the main UI thread.
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the FilesSettingsView.swift type and its public members.
Public APIs match Swift naming conventions and are documented in code comments.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Default: Lines on, wrap off, tabs=4, unified diff
ui_interactions: Select diff style → Diff view updates
ui_copy: Labels: "Line Numbers", "Word Wrap", "Tab Size", "Diff Style", "Syntax Theme"
edge_cases: Very long lines + no wrap - horizontal scroll
Mixed tab/space files - show as configured tab size
Missing dependencies should fall back to safe defaults without crashing.
failure_modes: Invalid tab size value - default to 4
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
